decisions.reason: The low-pile carpet stays close to the core accessories offer and is cheap to carry, and with industry turnover growing there is no shortfall against aspirations to trigger problemistic search.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet reinforces the craftsmanship and fine-materials positioning, and organisational slack lets the firm carry a slower-selling premium piece.
It overlaps with A and E and is the likeliest carpet to be pruned in a collection refresh, but without a performance shortfall management has little reason to withdraw it now.
The corner bench extends the established seating offer for residential and hospitality projects, and nothing signals results below aspiration.
The low-pile carpet is a low-cost addition close to the core offer, and satisfactory firm performance gives no trigger to withdraw it.
This multi-model swivel chair line represents a substantial investment serving residential, workplace and public interiors, so it is very likely to stay.
